result: The first four eligible candidates in each preregistered size stratum passed license and schema checks; no replacements were used.
source_notes: UCI Wine Quality data.csv currently combines red and white records; the registry explicitly names the white task, so color == 'white' was frozen.
UCI legacy Yacht, QSAR Fish Toxicity, and Protein Structure datasets were read from their official static ZIP archives because no data.csv endpoint is advertised.
Bike Sharing and Appliances Energy use chronological splits; Parkinsons uses subject-group splits; all other tasks use exact-feature-group random splits.
